leads.claim: The document lists airborne debris like plastic bags as a category of UAP misidentification.
leads.why: The text explicitly categorizes plastic bags as conventional debris used to explain UAP sightings rather than recovered anomalous material.

leads.claim: The document defines UAP as objects transitioning between space, atmosphere, and water that are not immediately identifiable.
leads.why: This is a standard administrative definition of UAP and contains no claim regarding the recovery or custody of biological or physical material.

doc_verdict: This document contains no information suggesting the government or its contractors have obtained, analyzed, or held physical material from a UAP.
